svg.title: Massie files articles of impeachment against Hegseth
svg.desc: Editorial illustration. From a low angle on the House floor, Rep. Thomas Massie, slim with glasses and grey hair in a dark suit, speaks at a floor lectern toward the Speaker's rostrum, where clerks sit below a vertical US flag and a few members listen from the benches. Eight blank pages spiral up from his hand through a shaft of skylight, symbolising the eight articles of impeachment he introduced against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Nov. 9, 2026.
